# Describe the dialog script and style policies separately

The current commonDialog document explicitly permits chrome and moz-src script sources while style-src still includes unsafe-inline. The historical port removed inline event handlers, not all inline CSS. For this dialog, describe the specific script event migration rather than claiming a universal ban on inline markup. This is a scoped source and documentation pattern; effective policy behavior was not tested. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.

Scope: mail / base.
